name: Canvas Tent
desc1: Although quite small by normal living standards, all available space
desc2: in this cleverly-made home is used efficiently. Thick, hollow poles
desc3: form the framework for the tent, while the cloth is sturdy and tear-
desc4: resistant. A small firepit, currently extinguished, is set in the
desc5: centre of the floor, and a sleeping mat lays against one wall.
desc6: Cookware, clothing and other used items are stored in convenient
desc7: chests and boxes which take up the rest of the available room.
